title: Folder of another Nextcloud (public link)
description: The files of a folder someone shared by a public link from their Nextcloud. After saving, set the job's account to an rclone configuration: [share], type = webdav, vendor = nextcloud, url = https://their.cloud/public.php/webdav, user = the link's last part (the share's token).
